name: The Devil You Know
overview: In an atmosphere of desire and danger, a group of men finds themselves caught in a web of secrets and temptations that challenge their morality. Under the watchful eye of an enigmatic figure, the lines between passion and possession begin to blur. As hidden truths emerge beneath the heat of the flames, each must decide how far they are willing to go to satisfy their deepest instincts. In a game where pleasure walks hand in hand with risk, they will discover that the true "devil" might be closer than they imagine—often reflected in the mirror or in the touch of the one they love.
